design: Plain JS, no new deps, three pieces. A) Inline comments (renderer only). Shared state in extras.js: `const rascunhos = []` of {id,file,line,side:'D'|'E',text,trecho} (D = new/right side, E = old/left side). diffGitHtml (os.js:90) and diffDe (extras.js:21) add to each row `data-arq`, `data-linha`, `data-lado` and a `+`; Edit/MultiEdit rows have line=null plus the code text in `trecho` because tool input has no file line numbers. One delegated document-level click handler `abreCaixaComentario(rowEl)` inserts a `.cm-caixa` (textarea + Salvar/Cancelar; Ctrl+Enter saves, Esc cancels) after the row; `salvaRascunho()` pushes to rascunhos and marks the row `.comentada`; `desenhaBarraComentarios()` renders a bar above #composer ("N comentários pendentes" + Enviar (Ctrl+Enter) + Limpar + a chip list with remove). `enviaComentarios()` builds the message via `formataComentarios(rascunhos)`: header 'Comentários de revisão no diff:' then, grouped by file, `- arquivo:linha (lado novo|antigo): texto` plus the code snippet in a fenced line when trecho exists; then calls existing `envia(texto)` (app.js:399), which already picks vivo.injetar vs vivo.enviar, and clears rascunhos on success. Ctrl+Enter anywhere with drafts pending and empty composer triggers it. No new IPC. B) report_findings tool (main.js:210). zod schema as in integration points; handler returns texto() only. The in-chat card is rendered by the renderer from the existing 'ferramenta' event/history replay: app.js ferramenta() early-branches on nome 'mcp__claudie__report_findings' to `cartaoRevisao(entrada)` which builds a `.msg claude` block listing findings sorted by severity (badge, file:line link that calls vivo.abrirArquivo, summary, suggestion), per-finding buttons 'Corrigir este' and 'Explicar passo a passo' and a header 'Aplicar todas as correções'. Each button calls `envia(prompt)`: fix -> `Corrija este achado e só ele: : — . Sugestão: `; walk -> `Explique passo a passo este achado sem editar nada: ...`; all -> list all achados, 'Aplique as correções de todos os achados acima, um por um.' Prompts must not start with '/'. Add the tool to FERRAMENTAS_TEMA (main.js:227) so allowedTools skips the permission card, and mention it in the server instructions. C) Review trigger. `revisaMudancas()` (os.js, global like alteracoes()) calls envia with: 'Revise as mudanças atuais do repositório (rode git diff HEAD e leia o necessário). Depois chame a ferramenta mcp__claudie__report_findings uma vez com cada achado (file, line, severity, summary, suggestion); não liste os achados em texto.' Wired to the new 'Revisar mudanças' button in abreAlteracoes top bar (os.js:108) and to the app-only command `/review-changes` intercepted in envia() beside /customize (app.js:411), plus a local entry in the slash picker list. If the message is sent while a turn runs, envia already injects it. Strings added to a new i18n part. Verify by node --check on all touched files and VIVO_TESTE with a git-dirty folder.

risks: Edit/MultiEdit tool input carries no absolute file line numbers, so comments on chat Edit cards cannot have a true line; design sends file + code snippet instead (spec's `line` is null there).

git diff in the Changes window is re-rendered on each 'parado'/'sessao' event and 'Atualizar' (os.js:176), which wipes open comment boxes; drafts live in module state and are re-marked after redraw, but an open textarea mid-typing is lost unless redraw is skipped while a .cm-caixa is open.
Line numbers in drafts go stale if the file changes after commenting; message says 'no diff at time of comment'.
report_findings relies on the model following instructions; if it lists findings in text instead, no card shows. Instructions string and the prompt of /review-changes both tell it to call the tool.
If an old conversation is replayed without the claudie MCP server (tool name present in history), the card still renders from history because it keys off tool name, which is desired.
Generated prompts beginning with '/' would be treated as slash commands by montaPrompt (main.js:256, 895); keep them starting with a letter.
diffGitHtml cuts diffs at 600 lines and diffDe at 400, so comment buttons are absent past the cut.
i18n parts discovery not confirmed (no JS reference to file names found by grep); verify it is globbed before relying on a new file.
